question: Прочитай весь январский корпус ниже как исторический witness развития JANUS. Ищи не новое мистическое место, а паттерн FOUND_LONG_AGO_RECOGNIZED_LATE: вещь или структура могла уже лежать перед исследователем, но её функция/идентичность была понята позже. Внутренне проведи ПРОШЛОЕ / ПРЕГРАДА / СОВЕТ / ИТОГ. Затем дай один краткий ответ на русском: (1) какая ОДНА коррекция JANUS наиболее важна; (2) какой ОДИН уже известный объект/класс из current_osiris_evidence следует первым переопознать по этому паттерну; (3) какой ОДИН архивный/консервационный/неразрушающий gate способен это подтвердить или опровергнуть. Не утверждай сверхъестественный контакт, пророчество, P=NP или доказанную идентичность реликвии. Не придумывай новых каталожных номеров.

january_corpus.name: Hephaestus Crystal / Quantum ideal packing
claims_and_text: JANUS announced that Quantum-P=NP was confirmed and that quantum entropy reduction/full-success simulation proved a far-reaching result.

A proposed route used Modified Hardware + Shor Adaptation + quantum logic; an SQL row recorded: theory_name='Quantum-P=NP', iteration_index=2, strategy_variant='Modified Hardware + Shor Adaptation', outcome_log='SUCCESS: Solved via Quantum Logic Bypass. Sorting step replaced by Period Finding.'.

The reconstruction proposed QND-style non-demolition measurements, an alleged conversion of NP search to period finding, and amplitude amplification; none of those steps supplied a valid general reduction/proof.

quantum_success_sim.py generated a four-qubit circuit and, if Qiskit was unavailable, a hard-coded fallback distribution {'0000':12,'0101':480,'1010':495,'1111':37}. A heuristic then declared SOLUTION_VERIFIED when the top two states exceeded 80 percent of shots. This was simulation-driven promotion, not proof.

Hephaestus Crystal scanned filesystem metadata, used block_size=4096, calculated actual per-file cluster slack, and compared it to an idealized zero-slack 'Quantum Stream'. It stored entropy/crystal-purity reports in janus.db. The useful physical observation was real slack accounting; the zero-slack quantum ideal was an assumed comparison state, not a P=NP result.
The January wording explicitly moved from 'Theoretical Perfection' to 'Engineering Realization' and asked how far the real filesystem is from an ideal crystal state.
january_corpus.surviving_pattern: An ideal state can be useful as a target metric even when the claimed mechanism for reaching it is unproved. Separate measured slack from simulated ideal slack.

january_corpus.name: The Genetic Archiver / Hephaestus Genetic
claims_and_text: Real-world problem: thousands of small files each waste tail space because allocation occurs in 4096-byte clusters.
JANUS proposed a genetic algorithm that searches combinations of files and tries to form 'Perfect Crystals' whose summed payload size is divisible by 4096 when placed in a store-mode container.

Concrete example: A=4097 bytes and B=4095 bytes separately consume 8192+4096 allocated bytes and lose a combined 4096 bytes of tail space; together their payload is 8192 bytes, exactly two 4096-byte blocks before container overhead.

The preserved GeneticPacker uses block_size=4096, population_size=50, generations=30, mutation_rate=0.1; scans files with size modulo 4096 nonzero; caps the pool at a random sample of 500; creates genomes of 5..20 files; fitness is zero when total_size modulo 4096 is zero and otherwise 4096-remainder; top 20 percent survive; mutation adds/removes a file; PERFECT CRYSTAL FOUND stops the search.

The important conceptual sentence is: the desired combination already exists among the input files; evolution does not create the arithmetic equality from nothing, it recognizes a useful grouping that was previously hidden in the disorder.

Container headers/metadata and filesystem implementation can add overhead, so payload divisibility alone is not proof of literal zero physical slack for an actual archive. The algorithm remains a finite packing heuristic, not a P=NP proof.
january_corpus.surviving_pattern: FOUND_LONG_AGO_RECOGNIZED_LATE / correct grouping can reveal a structure already present in the corpus.

january_corpus.name: Quantum-P=NP + PhysarumComputer
claims_and_text: Legacy formula: P=NP iff exists A in P: for all x in {0,1}^n, A(x)=1 iff x in L. Later correction: L must be a fixed NP-complete language and the quantification must cover all input lengths; A is a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm/machine rather than a language element.

Legacy quantum pipeline: |psi>=Hadamard^n|0^n>; U=product Controlled-NOT_{i,i+1}; |psi>=U|psi>; y=Sort(|psi>). Later fail-closed test showed H^n creates a uniform superposition and a CNOT chain merely permutes equal-amplitude basis states, so the state remains language-blind. Sort on an unmeasured state is undefined as written; measurement followed by bit sorting remains independent of the target language. This refutes this specific candidate as a universal decider, not P=NP or P!=NP.

Physarum v1.0 was a graph-memory optimizer: ingest Hippocampus graph, create undirected conductivities, choose two random food nodes, run weighted random walks, retain the shortest found path, crystallize a shortcut into memory. Parameters included agent_count=50, decay_rate=0.95, growth_rate=1.2.

A separate bridge wrote biological-computation observations into janus.db and historically promoted P_EQUALS_NP to status PROVEN_BY_PHYSARUM. That promotion is now classified as invalid because finite path finding does not imply a general polynomial solver.

The surviving Physarum principle is selection/reinforcement: many candidate routes/forms compete; weak routes decay; useful structural survivors are proposed. A separate exact verifier must decide whether a proposed merge/path is logically valid.
january_corpus.surviving_pattern: GENERATOR_NE_VERIFIER; FOUND_NE_PROVED; structural compression can survive after theorem claims are removed.

modern_janus_correction_context.formula_caching: Q0/Q1 work now treats bytewise-different residuals as mergeable only with proof-preserving structural certificates and witness lift; heuristic generation never grants theorem status.
modern_janus_correction_context.recognition_rule: The strongest January lesson is not 'P=NP was solved' but 'a useful structure may already be present in the archive and only later receive the correct classification'.

facts: Quibell 1902 documents gold funerary body-part sheaths including a phallus sheath in the Nesbanebdjedet burial at Mendes.
Nesbanebdjedet held an Osirian priestly title, Prophet of Osiris in Anpet.
The burial assemblage suffered documented unauthorized removal before official recovery.
The Met links gold funerary equipment from this burial to Cairo CG 53465-53469.
The exact CG number corresponding to the documented phallus sheath remains unresolved in the current audit.
MENDES_1902_CG53465_53469_ASSEMBLAGE.recognition_question: Could the desired object already be in the known Mendes accession cluster but catalogued/functionally described under a nonliteral class or with unresolved concordance?

facts: Mendes is phallus-specific in Egyptian ritual geography and has incomplete early excavation provenance.
A ritual substitute, amulet, insert, fragment or secondary-custody object is a search class, not an established original relic.
Dendera preserves Osirian relic-simulacrum and body-part vessel/container traditions.
A container may be important even when the external morphology does not look phallic.
Book of the Dead traditions support protective custody of Osirian body components.
Hollow/sealed/nested sacred containers are material controls, but phallus-specific custody is not established.
British Museum 1973,0501.23 is a separate hand-modelled terracotta phallus insert about 6.60 x 1.70 cm.
Its internal hollow/solid state and damaged-root structure remain potentially testable by non-destructive imaging.
It lacks strong direct Osirian provenance and is therefore a technology/control branch, not the leading identity candidate.
Gold phallic amulets provide material/type controls.
Direct identification with an Osirian original relic is absent.

available_verification_gates: Resolve Cairo CG 53465-53469 object-card concordance item by item.
Obtain dimensions, full photographs and conservation records for the Mendes 1902 gold body-part sheaths.
Audit JE/CG transfer and early-removal records for objects separated from the Nesbanebdjedet assemblage.
Search catalogue vocabulary beyond phallus: ritual substitute, amulet, votive, insert, unidentified fragment, body-part symbol, reliquary, packet.
Use radiography/micro-CT only where a known object's internal state is genuinely unresolved.
Reject identity if provenance, morphology, material history or conservation record contradict the proposed link.
